verdict.rationale: Featurebase claims AI helps 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities' from feedback data (docs-7), and separately offers AI-powered search answers (docs-14) and a Reports API exposing the analytics engine (docs-25). However, there is no detailed documentation of how insights/suggestions are generated, no examples of AI-generated summaries or recommendations in the dashboard, and no independent corroboration of this specific capability. missing for 10: detailed docs/screenshots of AI insight generation, independent user corroboration, technical depth on the 'declutter' AI feature.
